```{r function to create definitive positive matrix and cm, include=FALSE}
def_pos_mat <- function(num) {
  A <- matrix(runif(num^2)*2-1, ncol=num) 
  return (t(A) %*% A)
}

draw_confusion_matrix <- function(cm) {
  
  #layout(matrix(c(1,1,2)))
  par(mar=c(2,2,2,2))
  plot(c(100, 345), c(300, 450), type = "n", xlab="", ylab="", xaxt='n', yaxt='n')
  
  # create the matrix 
  rect(150, 430, 240, 370, col='#3F97D0')
  text(195, 435, '0', cex=3)
  rect(250, 430, 340, 370, col='#F7AD50')
  text(295, 435, '1', cex=3)
  text(125, 370, 'Predicted', cex=3, srt=90, font=2)
  text(245, 450, 'Actual', cex=3, font=2)
  rect(150, 305, 240, 365, col='#F7AD50')
  rect(250, 305, 340, 365, col='#3F97D0')
  text(140, 400, '0', cex=3, srt=90)
  text(140, 335, '1', cex=3, srt=90)
  
  # add in the cm results 
  res <- as.numeric(cm$table)
  text(195, 400, res[1], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(195, 335, res[2], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(295, 400, res[3], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(295, 335, res[4], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
}  
```

```{r create synthetic data, include=FALSE}
# https://www.r-bloggers.com/2016/02/generating-and-visualizing-multivariate-data-with-r/

library(MASS)
set.seed(params$seed)
n_feats <- 100

# Mean
mu_a_yg <- runif(n = n_feats, min = 1, max = 50)
mu_b_yg <- mu_a_yg/3
mu_c_yg <- rnorm(n = n_feats)

mu_a_old <- runif(n = n_feats, min = 1, max = 50)
mu_b_old <- mu_a_old/2
mu_c_old <- rnorm(n = n_feats)
# Covariance matrix
sigma_a_yg <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)  
sigma_b_yg <- sigma_a_yg/3  
sigma_c_yg <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)   

sigma_a_old <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)
sigma_b_old <- sigma_a_old/2
sigma_c_old <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)  

# Generate sample from N(mu, Sigma)
bivn_a_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_a_yg, Sigma = sigma_a_yg )
bivn_b_yg <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_b_yg, Sigma = sigma_b_yg )
bivn_c_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_c_yg, Sigma = sigma_c_yg )

bivn_a_old <- mvrnorm(1500, mu = mu_a_old, Sigma = sigma_a_old )
bivn_b_old <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_b_old, Sigma = sigma_b_old )
bivn_c_old <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_c_old, Sigma = sigma_c_old )

y_a <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1500))
y_b <- c(rep(0, 1000), rep(1, 2000))
y_c <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1000))

x_a <- rbind(bivn_a_yg, bivn_a_old)
x_b <- rbind(bivn_b_yg, bivn_b_old)
x_c <- rbind(bivn_c_yg, bivn_c_old)

xdata <- scale(rbind(x_a, x_b, x_c))
ydata <- c(y_a, y_b, y_c)
ylabel <- c(rep("a",length(y_a)), rep("b",length(y_b)), rep("c", length(y_c)))

feature_cols <- which(!colnames(dataset) %in% "ydata")

rm(y_a, y_b, y_c, bivn_a_yg, bivn_b_yg, bivn_c_yg, bivn_a_old, 
   bivn_b_old, bivn_c_old, sigma_a_yg, sigma_b_yg, sigma_c_yg, sigma_a_old,
   sigma_b_old, sigma_c_old, mu_a_yg, mu_b_yg, mu_c_yg, mu_a_old, mu_b_old,
   mu_c_old)

data <- data.frame(xdata, y = ydata, label = ylabel)
```

```{r split data and build correlation matrices, include=FALSE}
#Define train and test data
itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), nrow(xdata)*.9))

# this part should receive an arbitrary number of matrices
groups <- unique(data[,'label'])
group_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- data[which(data[,'label'] == groups[i]),!colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label")]
}

# normalizing data
group_list <- lapply(group_list, scale)

## correlation matrices
group_cor <- lapply(group_list, function (x) propagate::bigcor(x, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE))
group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) as.data.frame(ff::as.ffdf(x)))
```

```{r distwiner benchmarking helper functions}
compute_twiner_weights <- function(group_cor, n_feats, transform_fn, aggregate_fn) {
  group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor), 2)
  n_pairs     <- ncol(group_combs)
  weight_mat  <- matrix(0, nrow = n_pairs, ncol = n_feats)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_feats)) {
    for (k in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
      raw <- lsa::cosine(
        group_cor[[ group_combs[1, k] ]][, i],
        group_cor[[ group_combs[2, k] ]][, i]
      )
      weight_mat[k, i] <- transform_fn(raw)
    }
  }
  apply(weight_mat, 2, aggregate_fn)
}

evaluate_and_save <- function(model, fit, xdata, ydata, itrain, ang_weight, base_dir,
                              pred_fn = function(f) predict(f, newx = xdata[-itrain,], type = "class"),
                              prob_fn = function(f) predict(f, newx = xdata[-itrain,], type = "response")[, 1]) {
  ypred  <- pred_fn(fit)
  ytest  <- ydata[-itrain]
  
  # Confusion matrix
  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(table(ypred, ytest))
  pdf(file.path(base_dir, "performance", "confusionMatrix", paste0(model, ".pdf")))
  draw_confusion_matrix(cm)
  dev.off()
  saveRDS(cm, file.path(base_dir, "performance", "confusionMatrix", paste0(model, ".rds")))
  
  # Metrics
  yprob <- prob_fn(fit)
  metrics <- list(
    precision = Metrics::precision(ytest, as.numeric(ypred)),
    recall    = Metrics::recall(ytest, as.numeric(ypred)),
    f1        = Metrics::f1(ytest, as.numeric(ypred)),
    roc       = pROC::roc(ytest, yprob),
    weight_sd = if (!is.null(ang_weight)) sd(ang_weight) else NA
  )
  for (nm in names(metrics)) {
    saveRDS(metrics[[nm]], file.path(base_dir, "performance", nm, paste0(model, ".rds")))
  }
  invisible(metrics)
}
```

```{r distwiner variants benchmark}
linear_dissim <- function(raw) 1 - acos(raw) / pi

model_configs <- list(
  list(name = "mean-linear",    transform = linear_dissim, aggregate = mean),
  list(name = "maximum-linear", transform = linear_dissim, aggregate = max),
  list(name = "minimum-linear", transform = linear_dissim, aggregate = min),
  list(name = "maxMean-linear", transform = linear_dissim,
       aggregate = function(x) mean(x[x >= quantile(x, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)])),
  list(name = "minMean-linear", transform = linear_dissim,
       aggregate = function(x) mean(x[x <= quantile(x, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)])),
  list(name = "minimum-exp",    transform = function(r) exp(linear_dissim(r)), aggregate = min),
  list(name = "minimum-sig",    transform = function(r) 1 / (1 + exp(-linear_dissim(r))), aggregate = min)
)

for (cfg in model_configs) {
  ang_weight <- compute_twiner_weights(group_cor, n_feats, cfg$transform, cfg$aggregate)
  
  # Weight distribution plot
  p <- ggplot(data.frame(weight = ang_weight), aes(x = weight)) + ...
  ggsave(file.path(params$BASE_DIR, "featureWeight", paste0(cfg$name, ".pdf")), p, width = 9)
  
  fit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]),
                           family = "binomial", nfolds = 10, alpha = 0.9,
                           penalty.factor = ang_weight, type.measure = "mse")
  saveRDS(fit, file.path(params$BASE_DIR, "trainedModels", paste0(cfg$name, ".rds")))
  
  evaluate_and_save(cfg$name, fit, xdata, ydata, itrain, ang_weight, BASE_DIR)
}
```

```{r performance - svm}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#Train model and save
model <- "svm"

dataset <- data.frame(cbind(xdata, ydata))
dataset$ydata <- factor(dataset$ydata, levels = c(0, 1)) 

training_set = dataset[itrain,]
test_set = dataset[-itrain,]

training_set[,feature_cols] = scale(training_set[,feature_cols]) 
test_set[,feature_cols] = scale(test_set[,feature_cols]) 

classifier = e1071::svm(formula = ydata ~ ., 
                        data = training_set, 
                        type = 'C-classification', 
                        kernel = 'linear', probability = TRUE)

saveRDS(classifier, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/trainedModels/", 
                           model, 
                           ".rds"))

y_pred = predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[,feature_cols]) 

# Accuracy and confusion matrix
xtab <- table(y_pred, ydata[-itrain])
cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(xtab)
cm
pdf(paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/confusionMatrix/", 
           model, 
           ".pdf"))
draw_confusion_matrix(cm)
dev.off()
saveRDS(cm, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/confusionMatrix/", 
                   model, 
                   ".rds"))

# Precision
precision <- Metrics::precision(ydata[-itrain], as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(precision, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/precision/", 
                          model, 
                          ".rds"))

# Recall
recall <- Metrics::recall(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(recall, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/recall/", 
                       model, 
                       ".rds"))

#F1 Score
f1 <- Metrics::f1(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(f1, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/f1Score/", 
                   model, 
                   ".rds"))

#ROC Curve AUC
yprobabilities <- predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[feature_cols], type = "prob", probability = TRUE)
yprobabilities <- attr(yprobabilities,"probabilities")[,2]
roc <- pROC::roc(ydata[-itrain], yprobabilities)
saveRDS(roc, paste0(params$BASE_DIR, "/performance/rocAUC/", 
                    model, 
                    ".rds"))
```
